notes.title: Zekus Forgate and Lilahammer Join Last Cloudia! ＆ 4.5 Year Anniversary Promotion
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/ab5441e53c8f3b904f19b3727bc7c08dc6791039.jpg
On October 12, post-maintenance, the Descent of Heroes Festival and the Step Up Descent of Heroes Festival will be released!

New Unit
Zekus Forgate (Voice: Ryota Osaka)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/63abda2289ce6d04182715288c100169250fd3c6.jpg

New Ark
Lilahammer (UR)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/c8c1a4fba4bbc8b3d81ee2b9857b343ea566e12a.jpg

Ark Trait (Ark Lv 15)
All-enemy attack magic damage +30%.
Cut physical/ magic damage taken (max -40%; each wave, gradually cut effect).
When casting magic, boost the magic’s damage cap based on amonunt of MP used (max +6000 at 200+ MP used).
*Excludes magic that regularly deals damage.

100% Ark Ether Reward
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/2dfce0f2b3516574d56ccc6953db9aa0fb6f1da5.png



Daily Free 10-Spin Gacha Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/8b0569acba108a9a9fe133000895827fda9e14ea.jpg
This is a free 10-spin gacha that you can spin once per day!
Don’t forget to spin every day!

[Points]
• This is a free 10-spin gacha that you can spin once per day, for up to 250 times!
• Descent of Heroes Festival-limited units and UR arks are also in the draw pool for this gacha!
• Each time you spin the gacha, you’ll get 100 4.5 Year Anniv Medals, which can be exchanged for various items!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Nov 8, 10:59 pm (PT)



Event 4.5 Year Anniversary Festival Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/298e4dc04660bfb3e4d1f94887d08d9abf548026.jpg
This quest celebrates the 4.5 year anniversary of Last Cloudia.
If you clear it, you’ll get 3000 crystals, so don’t miss it!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Nov 8, 10:59 pm (PT)



4.5 Year Anniversary Special Gift
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/589037e28d9254fbeeab22c0a2788c01f846aa3b.png
The 4.5 Year Anniversary Special Gift will appear on the upper left of the Home screen!
Claim this gift to receive a ★4.5YearAnniv UR Ark Trade Ticket, which can be used to trade for a UR ark of your choice in the lineup.
Once you get it, use it in the 4.5 Year Anniversary UR Ark Trading Space!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Nov 8, 10:59 pm (PT)



Event Anniversary Match Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/84d2df49e0a3763e432cab2c5c5de8dc79fe02ef.jpg
In this event, you can play quests that help with training your units.
When you clear these quests, there’s a chance that bonus quests which support multiplayer will appear! Take them on to get various materials and ★Cadet Tickets to train your units!

For a limited time only during this event, certain Celebratory series equipment from past anniversary events will be able to be godforged and enhanced.
This will be the first redux for incredibly powerful equipment like Celebratory Ring and Celebratory Medal, so you won’t want to miss this chance!

[Event Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Oct 25, 11:59 pm (PT)




Collect 4.5 Year Anniv Medals!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/452fb206c2f4210a03866391029439207dd5c2a4.jpg
During the event, you’ll be able to get 4.5 Year Anniv Medals from various locations.
Amazing rewards like ★4.5 Year Anniv Gacha Tickets and Crystal Ultraclusters of each color have been added to the Trading Space lineup!
Collect lots of medals and exchange them for items!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Nov 8, 10:59 pm (PT)



4.5 Year Anniversary Last Cloudia Popularity Poll Prelims Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/4d0abae6c21732181916925fc46856e569fbc574.jpg
The Last Cloudia Popularity Poll is split up into two rounds: prelims and finals. The prelims will begin on Oct 12, and the finals will begin on Oct 26.
The finals will include the ten most popular units from the prelims. The most popular unit from the finals will get a shift that will be released at a later date.

[Voting Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Oct 22, 7:59 am (PT)



4.5 Year Anniversary Login Bonus Pt. 1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/192a1f75c4cd427b3303772d9092f8ce7b148755.png
A login bonus celebrating Last Cloudia’s 4.5 year anniversary will be released!
You can get a Luminous Soul (a rare item used for ◆7+ awakening) and ★4.5 Year Anniv Gacha Tickets, so you’ll definitely want to log in every day to get all of the magnificent items in this login bonus!



New Story Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/1d6c06833a8c4199ea3940451cdc4e155c5082cb.jpg
Log in daily for rare and useful gifts from this login bonus!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Oct 25, 11:59 pm (PT)




Thank you for your continued support of Last Cloudia.
The Last Cloudia Team

notes.content:

On July 13, 2023, post-maintenance, the Descent of Heroes Festival and the Step Up Descent of Heroes Festival will be released!

[Period]
July 13, post maintenance – Aug 9, 11:59 pm (PT)

New Unit
Divine Beast Thouzer (Voice: Yuuichirou Umehara)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/e5b86e6760b1de2bdc6d2b9ca8a2448ea72a0e92.jpg
New Ark
Thrall of God, Apropolika (UR)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/0335f30dc4dd5421cf295c659e1f148f62f36d5b.jpg
Ark Trait (Ark Lv 15)
HP +30%, but when far enough from enemy, magic attack damage taken +10%.
The first 10 seconds of battle, give STR/ INT -50% debuff to all enemies.
Dark attack damage +20%/ damage cap +2500.

100% Ark Ether Reward
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/1d064a7b11ac9886d4d0fb7650d6cab5c230ae88.png

Event An Executioner Bemused by Blood Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/8c95d379c5efc4a1c9bdcd46b9e7022934a9ee14.jpg
In this event, play quests to collect tickets that you can use to take on the Extra Challenge, which gives amazing rewards.
Clearing the Extra Challenge will reward you with high rarity godforge alchemy materials and enhancement materials, so don’t miss out on playing it!

Additionally, some equipment can be enhanced using alchemy for a limited time only during this event.
Don’t miss out!

▼Summary
In a time before Thouzer, the warden of Penal Island Pantorbane, had his chance encounter with a certain one-winged divine beast,
he has been granted the rank and power of a thrall of god by the Goddess. In order to test this power, he enters the depths of the island…

It is here, in the deepest depths of Penal Island Pantorbane,

that prisoners with powers beyond human control have been imprisoned,
since even before Thouzer became the warden.

[Period]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/6ee9d703b019ddc39681c1ea68fa34acacc7e6c7.jpg

Enjoy the ever-expanding world of Last Cloudia!

Log in daily to get training materials!

notes.title: Heavenly Knight Melza and Gallant Fire, Imperial Ice Join Last Cloudia!
notes.content:
■{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/ce850287670cb91fec35e98f64ba3a9ec0a7468d.jpg
On February 28, 2023, post-maintenance, the Blessings of Fire and Ice Gacha will be released!

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 29, 11:59 pm (PT)

New Unit
Heavenly Knight Melza (Voice: Chiwa Saito)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/e52d781c03fb87afce4f58b1ff2cb4ee91eb1757.png

New Ark
Gallant Fire, Imperial Ice (SSR)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/a2758dd362132840516861a506973d560b309711.png

Ark Trait (Ark Lv10)
When HP is 50% or more, STR+35%.
When HP is less than 50%, DEF/ MND +25%.
When taking lethal damage, survive and recover 50% HP (once per wave).
Battle Start: Autocast Fire Wall II and Ice Wall II on unit only.

100% Ark Ether Reward
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/6daa9fb77c557f259f8c35e56d7f5567964caba2.png

Event The White Knight Returns Released!
■{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/70e74e8728163fe73cc31b9343bc4bba38324e19.jpg
This event will be held on the exclusive event map Continent of Mordana.

Explore Melza’s backstory in more depth while also taking on challenges from the Monster Collector’s Manor.
Additionally, from part 2 of the event, new story, an extra challenge, and a superboss will also appear!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
▼Summary
Once, there was a trio who set out to save the world by slaying the God of Ruin.
However, after Vaughn and Seilios were defeated by the overwhelming power of Degrogue, one of the Four Lords of Ruin,
they vanished.
Then, White Knight Melza, engulfed in despair, became a servant of the God of Ruin.
As Soul Reaper Melza, she continues to reap even the smallest buds of hope from humanity to this day…
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~


Daily Free Blessings of Fire and Ice Gacha Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/2bba7ceebfc47c9e04cb886da5fd5554c4861622.jpg
This is a once daily one-spin gacha that you can spin for free, for a total of 17 free spins.

The new unit Heavenly Knight Melza and the new ark Gallant Fire, Imperial Ice are on rate-up, so don’t forget to spin the gacha every day!

Completing this quest will get you Godrelic Prism Shards and tons of Romantic Pokkle Cookies, so don’t forget to take it on every day!

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 15, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

Pokkle Cookie Trading Space
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/d1087a0149148120bdc213f8bcfc72a54d8c5f44.jpg
Trade in the Romantic Pokkle Cookies that you’ve collected for valuable items!
Cookies can be exchanged for items such as a ★Prism Exchange Ticket, which can be used to get a unit prism for a male unit, and each type of radiance.

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 22, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

White Day Login Bonus
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/7f5777926b2775e6d3037b20d146b3cb6d26e180.png
This login bonus gives Pokkle Cookies and Zekus Stamp!

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 15, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

White Day Step-Up Gacha Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/34653563a5aa0d2a1d04f8c7e32b461856fcd79f.png
This gacha is a step-up gacha that advances to the next step each time you spin the gacha.
You can pull up to the second lap only once.

[Gacha Points]
1.All steps can be spun with crystals!
2.Only male units appear!
These include Descent of Heroes Festival exclusive units!
*Some units will not appear.
3.Lap 2, Step 5 features a ★Unit Exchange Ticket that can be exchanged for one male unit!

*The unit Lougseus, God of Ruin’s gender is listed as unknown, and is therefore not a male unit; however, this unit will appear in this gacha.
This also applies to the ★Unit Exchange Ticket.
*Be sure to check the trading space lineup in advance.

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 15, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

Premium LC Pass Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/28ed312fc84ff2c1c104cccc755c590f7e94d621.jpg
We’ve added a new LC pass (subscription feature)!
The premium LC pass is a monthly subscription service that gives you the following perks for a modest price from the day you buy it.

You can get up to 4000 Crystals every month, so don’t miss out!

 

Thank you for your continued support of Last Cloudia.
The Last Cloudia Management Team

notes.title: Original Soundtrack Release Date Confirmed! Promo Event Starts Today!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/3c0f357ae6d021c7215d0e706abaadf22dd4c02e.jpg
Last Cloudia’s original soundtracks hit store shelves on October 15, 2022!

Vol. 1 of the soundtrack contains a total of 40 tracks, including fan-favorite songs such as Destiny and Last Cloudia. Vol. 2 contains 38 tracks, and features beloved tunes such as Path of Light and New Sky. As a bonus feature, all first pressing albums will come with a sticker of the jacket artwork.

Preorders start today. Add these Last Cloudia soundtracks to your collection and relive the adventure!

Place your preorder here:
https://bit.ly/3Q6cJPG

*We also plan to release the original soundtracks via digital distribution. More information will be available in the future.

Event Granzelia Descent Released!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/690f3d576fda7bf1f72787737e6a3a998cf57e3a.png

The event Granzelia Descent features a variety of quests, including time trials that make use of Last Cloudia’s new 3-party battle feature. As well as recreating the boss battle 2B and the others had with Simone, there is also a special fishing event to enjoy. Players can get units and arks, as well as 11 pieces of collab equipment and a ton of gacha tickets. Be sure to play the whole event, which runs through September 15, 2021, 11:59 pm (PT). *Fishing will be added on Sept. 2, and the time trial quest on Sept. 9.

To detail page



Collab Gacha Pt 1 Released!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/b655c156a307ec61c9de46ad30d7f21208ec8380.png

In this gacha, the unit 2B and the ark A Beautiful Songstress are on rate-up!

In Last Cloudia, 2B (voiced by Kira Buckland) is a nimble, no-attribute attacker who darts across the battlefield. Her skill kit includes excellent offensive and defensive capabilities: with the Type B skill, she can evade attacks and deals more physical attack damage as her combo hit count increases; and with the Support Unit: Pod 042, she regularly receives a variety of support effects. In addition, her unique skill Enhancement: Perfect Evade boosts her attack power and recovers SCT when she avoids a physical attack. Her other unique skill Equipment: Heavy Armor gives her continuous buffs. As you can see, she’s well equipped to handle any situation.
